        args:
        - --env

        - name: POD_ID
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.name
        - name: NAMESPACE_ID
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.namespace

        - name: RUNTIME_NAMESPACE

        image: ghcr.io/fluxcd/helm-controller:v0.1.3

            port: http-prom
